title: A Novel NR3C1 Frameshift Variant Associated With Familial Glucocorticoid Resistance Syndrome: An Integrated Analysis of Steroid Profiling and Structural Modeling.
authors: Yun, Sufang; Zhu, Zhifeng; Zhou, Fengye; Liu, Ying; Liang, Chunfang; Ju, Haitao; Lu, Lin; Yan, Zhaoli
journal: American journal of medical genetics. Part A
one_liner_zh: 该文报道NR3C1移码变异致糖皮质激素抵抗综合征，结合AlphaFold3结构预测评估突变影响，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作相关结构域但非核心机制研究，方法可迁移至TF-DNA建模。
abstract: Glucocorticoid resistance syndrome (GRS) is a rare hereditary disorder caused by pathogenic variants in NR3C1, characterized by marked phenotypic heterogeneity and frequent misdiagnosis as primary aldosteronism or subclinical Cushing's syndrome. We report a family harboring a novel NR3C1 frameshift variant and provide an integrated characterization of its clinical and biochemical features. By combining structural prediction, tissue- and single-cell-level expression analyses, in silico virtual gene perturbation, and systematic literature review, we evaluated the potential functional impact and clinical relevance of this variant. Comprehensive clinical phenotyping, steroid metabolomic profiling, adrenal CT imaging, and segregation analysis were performed in the proband and his father. AlphaFold3 was used to predict the structures of wild-type and mutant GRalpha proteins. Variant pathogenicity was assessed following ACMG/AMP criteria. Cross-tissue and single-cell expression patterns of NR3C1 were analyzed, and in silico virtual knockout analysis was performed to generate exploratory hypotheses regarding potentially affected biological pathways. A systematic review was conducted to summarize previously reported GRS cases, their variants, and associated phenotypes. Two affected males across successive generations presented with refractory hypertension without Cushingoid features. Steroid profiling demonstrated mild hypercortisolemia with elevated ACTH, marked increases in 11-deoxycorticosterone and 11-deoxycortisol, suppressed renin, and low-to-normal aldosterone, consistent with ACTH-driven accumulation of mineralocorticoid precursors. Sequencing identified a novel NR3C1 frameshift variant, c.923dupG (p.Ala309Serfs*6), absent from population databases and co-segregating with the familial phenotype. Structural prediction indicated premature termination within the N-terminal transactivation domain, supporting loss of the downstream DNA-binding and ligand-binding domains. According to ACMG/AMP criteria, the variant was classified as pathogenic. In silico virtual perturbation analysis suggested that NR3C1 dysfunction may extend beyond a linear defect in glucocorticoid signaling, potentially influencing neuroendocrine communication, extracellular matrix regulation, protein translation, and developmental pathways. Literature review identified 66 reported GRS cases encompassing substantial phenotypic variability, with cardiovascular events documented in some carriers of N-terminal or truncating variants. We describe a novel exon 2 NR3C1 frameshift variant that co-segregates with a characteristic GRS hormonal profile and is supported by clinical, genetic, and structural evidence. This case expands the genotype-phenotype spectrum of NR3C1-related GRS. The potential relationship between N-terminal truncating variants and cardiovascular complications remains hypothesis-generating and requires validation in larger cohorts and functional studies. Our findings underscore the importance of considering NR3C1-related GRS in patients presenting with resistant hypertension accompanied by a distinctive steroid profile.
abstract_zh: 糖皮质激素抵抗综合征（GRS）是一种由NR3C1致病性变异引起的罕见遗传性疾病，其特征为显著的表型异质性，并常被误诊为原发性醛固酮增多症或亚临床库欣综合征。我们报道了一个携带新型NR3C1移码变异的家系，并对其临床和生化特征进行了整合性描述。通过结合结构预测、组织及单细胞水平表达分析、计算机模拟虚拟基因扰动以及系统性文献综述，我们评估了该变异的潜在功能影响和临床相关性。对先证者及其父亲进行了全面的临床表型分析、类固醇代谢组学谱分析、肾上腺CT成像和分离分析。使用AlphaFold3预测野生型和突变型GRalpha蛋白的结构。依据ACMG/AMP标准评估变异致病性。分析了NR3C1的跨组织和单细胞表达模式，并进行计算机模拟虚拟敲除分析，以生成关于可能受影响的生物学通路的探索性假设。进行系统性综述以总结既往报道的GRS病例、其变异及相关表型。连续两代两名受累男性表现为难治性高血压，无库欣样特征。类固醇谱分析显示轻度高皮质醇血症伴ACTH升高，11-脱氧皮质酮和11-脱氧皮质醇显著增加，肾素受抑制，醛固酮低至正常水平，与ACTH驱动的盐皮质激素前体积累一致。测序鉴定出一个新型NR3C1移码变异c.923dupG（p.Ala309Serfs*6），该变异在群体数据库中不存在，并与家系表型共分离。结构预测表明N端反式激活结构域内发生提前终止，支持下游DNA结合结构域和配体结合结构域的缺失。根据ACMG/AMP标准，该变异被分类为致病性。计算机模拟虚拟扰动分析提示，NR3C1功能障碍可能不仅限于糖皮质激素信号传导的线性缺陷，还可能影响神经内分泌通讯、细胞外基质调节、蛋白质翻译和发育通路。文献综述确定了66例已报道的GRS病例，涵盖显著的表型变异性，其中部分携带N端或截短变异的个体记录有心血管事件。我们描述了一种新型外显子2 NR3C1移码变异，该变异与特征性GRS激素谱共分离，并得到临床、遗传和结构证据的支持。该病例扩展了NR3C1相关GRS的基因型-表型谱。N端截短变异与心血管并发症之间的潜在关系仍属假设生成性质，需在更大队列和功能研究中验证。我们的发现强调了在表现为难治性高血压并伴有独特类固醇谱的患者中考虑NR3C1相关GRS的重要性。
